title: Getting started with Doppler on iPhone, iPad and Mac
metaTitle: How to Set Up Doppler VPN on iPhone, iPad and Mac
metaDescription: Install Doppler VPN, connect in one tap, check what websites see, keep local sites local with Smart Route, and find the settings worth knowing on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
excerpt: Install, connect and find your way around the app in five minutes. No sign-up form and no configuration files.

faq.question: Which devices does Doppler run on?
faq.answer: iPhone and iPad with iOS or iPadOS 18 or later, and Mac with macOS 15 Sequoia or later. It is one App Store app, and there is a companion app for Apple Watch.

faq.question: Why does iOS ask to add a VPN configuration?
faq.answer: Every VPN app on iPhone and Mac has to register a VPN configuration with the system, and Apple asks you once before it does. Doppler cannot skip or answer that prompt for you.

faq.question: How do I know the VPN is working?
faq.answer: Open the Connection screen. It shows the IP address websites see right now and whether your DNS lookups go through the tunnel. If it shows your own address, the tunnel is not carrying your traffic.

faq.question: Does Smart Route make me less private?
faq.answer: Only for the sites you send direct. Those leave without the VPN, which is the point: local banks and services see a local address. Everything else stays in the tunnel. Smart Route is off until you switch it on.
